definition_quote.value: Any person practices in Missouri as a professional engineer who renders or offers to render or holds himself or herself out as willing or able to render any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, teaching of advanced engineering subjects or courses related thereto, design surveys and studies, the design coordination of services furnished by engineers and other consultants as they relate to engineering work, construction observation and the inspection of construction for the purpose of compliance with drawings and specifications, any of which embraces such service or work either public or private, in connection with any utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work systems or projects and including such architectural work as is incidental to the practice of engineering

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge", the independent direct control of a licensee's work and personal supervision of such work pertaining to the practice of architecture, engineering, land surveying, or landscape architecture.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Each architect and each professional engineer and each professional land surveyor and each professional landscape architect shall have a personal seal in a form prescribed by the board, and he or she shall affix the seal to all final technical submissions.

seal_document_types.quote: Technical submissions shall include, but are not limited to, drawings, specifications, plats, surveys, exhibits, reports, and certifications of construction prepared by the licensee, or under such licensee's immediate personal supervision.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: any professional engineer may practice his or her profession through the medium of, or as a member or as an employee of, a partnership or corporation if the plans, specifications, estimates, plats, reports, surveys or other like documents or instruments of the partnership or corporation are signed and stamped with the personal seal of the architect, professional engineer, professional land surveyor, or professional landscape architect by whom or under whose immediate personal supervision the same were prepared

value: Employees working under direction and continuing supervision of a currently licensed professional engineer
Regular full-time employees performing engineering work for their employer solely in connection with a facility owned/operated by that employer not affecting public health, safety, and welfare
Full-time employees in manufacturing operations whose engineering relates to manufacture, sale, or installation of products not affecting public health, safety, and welfare
Licensed architects, professional land surveyors, or professional landscape architects performing only incidental engineering
Persons rendering engineering services for a privately owned dwelling house, or small buildings (not more than two family or up to nine persons/less than 2,000 sq ft) who disclose non-licensure

Persons or corporations offering but not performing engineering services if licensed in state/country of residence or principal place of business
